LanguageData.Glitterstim.label: glitterstim
LanguageData.Glitterstim.description: Glitterstim is a potent variety of the drug family "spice" that is created by the Energy Spiders of Kessel. It gave the user a brief, yet pleasurable, telepathic boost and heightened mental state. It is a very valuable spice and is known to crackle and spark when ingested.
